newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria air cargo traffic up 83pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria air cargo traffic up 83pct in Feb.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport rose 83 percent in February, compared with the same month last year, to 2,905 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This follows a 17 percent fall in traffic in January and takes the total so far this year to 4,627 tonnes, a 26 percent increase on 1996.

Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent last year. It has become an important centre for frozen fish and express package freight, the authority said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
